name: NZBGet Queue
author: ky
description: Live NZBGet download speed in the bar, with the queue, pause/resume and a speed limit in the popup.

barWidget.description: Shows the current NZBGet download rate in the bar and hides while nothing is downloading. The popup lists each item with progress, size and ETA, and offers pause/resume plus a speed limit.

schema.label: Hide from the bar when nothing is downloading
